messages.subject: Error in `[<-.data.frame
parts:
Hi Guys, 
This might be a beginners question, but since I am not an R expert, I apologize if this one is too easy and I am just not knowledgeable enough. 
I am Trying to convert a SNP file to use SNAPP and here is what I get:

> TranslateBases(snpdata, translateMissing = FALSE, ordered = FALSE)
Error in `[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, j, , value = c("B", "E", "G", "I",  : 
  replacement has 12 items, need 37

Any advice on how to get around it?
I just need to convert my SNP alignment to the binary input for SNAPP. 

Thank you! :)

Silvia
